mapper.select: SELECT p.policy_id::TEXT AS row_id, p.title, p.type_cd, p.req_yn, p.sort_no FROM policy p WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.req_yn DESC, p.type_cd, p.sort_no
SELECT policy_id::TEXT FROM policy WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND req_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY policy_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_policy (member_id, policy_id, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{rowId}::integer, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp}) ON CONFLICT (member_id, policy_id) DO UPDATE SET use_yn = 'Y', upd_id = EXCLUDED.upd_id, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = EXCLUDED.upd_ip
mapper.select: SELECT policy_id::TEXT AS row_id, title, content, type_cd, req_yn, sort_no, use_yn FROM policy WHERE policy_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy (title, content, type_cd, req_yn, sort_no, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{typeCd}, COALESCE(#{reqYn}, 'Y'), -- 같은 약관유형(type_cd) 내 마지막 순서+1 자동 부여 COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_no), 0) + 1 FROM policy WHERE type_cd = #{typeCd} AND use_yn = 'Y')), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE policy SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type_cd = #{typeCd}, req_yn = #{reqYn}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE policy_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.select:
SELECT policy_id::TEXT AS row_id, sort_no FROM policy WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND type_cd = #{typeCd}
AND sort_no < #{sortNo}::integer ORDER BY sort_no DESC
AND sort_no > #{sortNo}::integer ORDER BY sort_no ASC
LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE policy SET sort_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE policy_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE policy SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE policy_id = #{rowId}::integer

UPDATE policy SET sort_no = sort_no - 1, upd_dt = NOW() WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND type_cd = (SELECT type_cd FROM policy WHERE policy_id = #{rowId}::integer) AND sort_no > (SELECT sort_no FROM policy WHERE policy_id = #{rowId}::integer)
